Chapter 254: Chapter 9: Physical Body Divine Ability, Mu Qingliu’s Decision (Please Subscribe)

The thousand-yard giant ape was strong.

This ‘strength’ was not limited to its physical body.

It was more about the mastery of space and other mysterious rules.

If someone thought that the thousand-yard giant ape was just a ‘dumb giant.’

They were greatly mistaken.

He could clash head-on with an Ancient Saint, the great prince of the Barbaric Demon Beast clan.

...

How could it rely solely on brute force?

Unfortunately,

The thousand-yard giant ape encountered Lin Yuan.

With the strength of the thousand-yard giant ape, even if it truly confronted an Ancient Saint,

it had the ability to save its own life.

After all, the Demon Saint’s Nest was not far away.

If the thousand-yard giant ape could hold out for a while,

the Demon Saint from the Demon Saint’s Nest would come to its aid.

However, in front of Lin Yuan, who had already stepped into the Body Cultivation Void,

the thousand-yard giant ape did not even last a breath before Lin Yuan trampled it to the brink of death with severe injuries.

This was the power of the Body Cultivation Void.

In the Central Divine Continent, this was an unprecedented power of the Body Cultivation line.

After stepping into the Body Cultivation Void, Lin Yuan faintly felt that with a single punch or kick, he could suppress the surroundings.

One force overcomes all laws.

This referred to the Body Cultivation.

“Since it’s almost dead, might as well…”

Lin Yuan looked down at the thousand-yard giant ape, spitting out blood, and suddenly made up his mind.

…

In the distance,

several demonic beasts watching in silence,

fell absolutely quiet, their gaze frozen.

What did they see?

Their great prince, in front of that seemingly insignificant member of the Human Race, had no power to fight back.

That was the great prince,

capable of contending with an Ancient Saint.

How could he be in such a state in front of Lin Yuan?

The demonic beasts looked at one another.

They instinctively felt, was their great prince too weak?

However, in an instant,

these demonic beasts realized.

How could the great prince be weak?

Throughout his journey, the great prince was famously fierce.

They knew it by heart.

Since it was not the great prince that was weak,

then it must be that the Human was too strong.

Strong enough that even the great prince had no ability to resist.

“Who exactly… who exactly is this Ancient Saint?”

“Aren’t they afraid of causing chaos across the world?”

The hearts of these demonic beasts trembled.

If this insignificant human could incapacitate the great prince with just a few kicks,

then it meant this person was undoubtedly at the level of an Ancient Saint.

Currently, Daode Immortal Sect rules the Central Earth, Ghost Palace of Netherworld, Blood Demon Sea, and Demon Saint’s Nest each occupy the south, north, and west of the Divine Continent, respectively.

But these four major forces abide by an ‘unwritten rule.’

That is, unless absolutely necessary, the Ancient Saints at the Refine Void level need not take action.

Even over a decade ago, when Daode Immortal Sect’s arrangement in the East Sea’s Black Gauze Archipelago was destroyed,

only an incarnation of the mirror descended from the Sect Master of Daode Immortal Sect, while the original body still sat in power on Mount Morality Immortal.

“Look, that person, what is he doing?”

The demonic beasts had scattered thoughts, their pupils suddenly constricting.

Because.

They saw—

That tiny Human Race being.

Heading towards the thousand-feet tall ape, opened its mouth to inhale.

In an instant.

The previously gasping thousand-feet tall ape saw its inner vitality and blood energy crazily draining away.

In less than a moment.

It turned into a skeleton.

“Not bad, not bad.”

“Almost equivalent to several dozen near Sixth Rank great medicines.”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

He had just broken through to the Body Cultivation Void, and although his combat power had surged, his body was weak due to the breakthrough.

This thousand-feet tall ape came at just the right time, directly serving as the nourishment for Lin Yuan to compensate for his weakness.

Just then.

Accompanied by the complete fall of the thousand-feet tall ape.

Deep within the Barbarian Wilderness, a tremendous aura began to awaken.

“That Demon Saint?”

Lin Yuan glanced over.

It was no secret that a Demon Saint was stationed at the Barbaric Demon Saint Nest.

However, this Demon Saint was mostly in a slumbering state.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan had no intention of engaging with that Demon Saint.

It wasn’t that Lin Yuan couldn’t handle the Demon Saint, but it was simply pointless.

Lin Yuan, not yet at the strength to dominate the world, saw retaining the Demon Saint to restrain the Daode Immortal Sect as beneficial, with no need to devastate them entirely.

A moment later.

A terrifying divine sense descended.

Transforming into an even more majestic and towering giant ape phantom.

“Who exactly is it?”

The giant ape phantom let out a deep roar, looking at the corpse of the Prince, raging intensely inside.

It had held great expectations for the Prince, and if everything had gone smoothly, the Prince only needed another five thousand years.

To reach the Refining Void Ancient Saint Layer.

At that time.

The Barbaric Demon Saint Nest would possess two Demon Saints.

Possibly even tamper with the Central Divine Continent.

But now.

The Prince was dead.

All its elaborate plans were shattered.

In the short run, among the countless Demonic Beasts of the Barbarian Wilderness, not one possessed the potential to ascend to Demon Saint.

“Hm?”

The giant ape phantom’s gaze shifted towards the distant, trembling Demonic Beasts.

Immediately, it raised its right hand, and those few Demonic Beasts appeared before it.

“Soul Search.”

The giant ape phantom’s mind slightly stirred.

The scenes the several Demonic Beasts had just witnessed.

Became vividly clear before it.

“Such strength?”

Seeing Lin Yuan effortlessly kill the Prince with several stomps, the giant ape phantom’s expression subtly changed.

“Involving no intricate rules, merely physical strength, such methods originate from the Human Race’s Body Cultivation. Could this person possibly be a Body Cultivator in the Refining Void Period?”

The giant ape phantom muttered to itself.

Body Cultivators are inherently proficient in physical combat, their combat power in the same layer is considered extremely strong, however, for various reasons, they have only been a subsidiary to the Immortal Path.

“Daode Immortal Sect? They nurtured a Body Cultivator in the Refining Layer?”

The giant ape phantom looked displeased.

No matter how one puts it, Body Cultivators are still a part of the Immortal Path.

Now that a Refine Void Body Cultivator has emerged, it could only attribute it to the Daode Immortal Sect.
